sources.label: Morphe patch source (RuTube and more). Add: github.com/virzak/morphe-patches
sources.author: RuTube
patch_list: Adds a badge to the launcher icon so the patched app is distinguishable from an unpatched install.
Prevents the ad SDK from starting, which stops banner ads and pre-roll video ads.
Allows playback to continue when the app is not in the foreground, which is otherwise only available with a paid subscription.
Allows downloading videos the app otherwise refuses, either because the uploader disabled downloads or because the video is longer than six hours.
Reports the account as subscribed to the app itself, which enables features gated behind a paid subscription such as background playback. Anything the server enforces is unaffected.
